verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Q poke before level 3 or sit on low HP near his E; you win every all-in once you have 4 Ionian Fervor stacks and his E is down.

brief.thesis: Urgot has 800 range on Q (Corrosive Charge) and a ranged poke tool before you have a reliable gap-closer worth trusting, so levels 1-2 are a slow bleed. Your Q (Bladesurge) resets off marks and kills, which lets you chain back-to-back dashes once his E (Disdain, cooldown 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) is on cooldown and you're stacked on Ionian Fervor — that's the entire lane plan.

theirWindow.when: His E is up and you're overextended
theirWindow.what: Disdain has 475 range and will catch you mid-dash, stopping to throw you out of position — don't commit Q (Bladesurge) into him while his E is available, since getting hurled resets your own aggression and can flip the trade.

yourWindow.when: His E is down, you're at 4 Ionian Fervor stacks
yourWindow.what: Engage immediately with E (Flawless Duet) to stun and Mark him, then Q (Bladesurge) in for the reset — with his E gone he has no way to disengage or reposition you, and Purge (W, cooldown 12/9/6/3/0s) alone won't save him at this stack count.

powerCurve.note: Q poke before you have a dash threat
E online, trades even if his E down
his R execute threat punishes overextension

start.why: Sustain and early trade damage to survive his Q poke range before you have Flash+Ignite or Exhaust online to punish all-ins.

boots.why: His autos and Echoing Flames passive are physical procs — Steelcaps flattens the poke damage you take while closing with Q.

core.why: The on-hit slow and %current-HP damage punish him for standing still to land Purge, and it fuels Ionian Fervor stacking for your all-in window.
Scales your dueling power for the level 9-13 spike where you're chaining Bladesurge resets.
Smooths the poke damage from Corrosive Charge into healing-over-time so extended trades don't bleed you out.

situational.when: he builds any armor and you need the magic damage and attack speed to keep stacking Ionian Fervor
you're ahead and want to burst through his HP before he can land Purge stacks
he's hitting his R (Fear Beyond Death) execute threshold on you in skirmishes
his team adds hard CC on top of his kit

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustained melee trades and dash-ins stack Conqueror fast, and the adaptive force/healing it grants offsets his ranged poke over a long lane.

summoners.why: Ignite punishes his low early sustain the moment you land a stun off E (Flawless Duet), and Flash protects your all-in commitment against his Disdain disengage.

playing.title: Hold Q until his E is down
playing.detail: Don't throw Bladesurge into him while Disdain is up — he'll stop the dash and throw you out of range, wasting your cooldown for nothing.

playing.title: Track your Ionian Fervor stacks
playing.detail: Don't commit to a full trade until you're at 4 stacks; the bonus on-hit damage is what turns an even trade into a won one.

playing.title: Punish Purge channel
playing.detail: W (Purge) slows him while it fires — use that window to land E (Flawless Duet) since he can't reposition out of the stun zone fast enough.

playing.title: Respect Corrosive Charge range before level 3
playing.detail: 800 range Q poke outranges your kit until you have E online — walk up in short windows, not a static trade stance.

playing.title: Watch his R timer post-6
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death has a 100/85/70/70/70s cooldown — once he's used it, you have a long window to all-in without the execute threat.

playing.title: Chain Bladesurge resets in skirmishes
playing.detail: If your E Mark lands or Q kills a minion near him, the reset lets you close distance again immediately — don't let the first dash be your only commitment.

playing.title: Play around BotRK timing
playing.detail: Once Blade of The Ruined King is up, your extended trades punish him for standing in Purge range — start forcing longer fights, not quick pokes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (845-game Irelia vs Urgot sample); the lane-phase reasoning and timing calls are my own read on the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being punished by Urgot’s (P) before reaching level 3. Maintain 4 stacks of [P] when engaging combat, while always keeping (E) in mind.
